blocks.text: Din ki lambai mein tabdeeli ka woh jawab jo podon ko apne mahol ki mausami tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalne deta hai, photoperiodism kehlata hai. Aasan alfaaz mein, yeh din aur raat ki lambai par podon ka jawab hai.

Photoperiodism ka asar sab se pehle 1920 mein Garner aur Allard ne parha. Unhon ne dekha ke tambaku (tobacco) ka poda sirf tab phool deta hai jab use lagataar kai chhote din milen. Tambaku qudrati taur par inhi halaat mein, yani khizan (autumn) mein, phool deta hai, magar use masnooi (artificial) taur par chhote din de kar bhi phool dilwaye ja sakte the. Mazeed tajurbon se unhon ne phooldar podon ko teen groups mein banta: long-day plants, jinhen phool ke liye lambe din chahiye; short-day plants, jinhen phool ke liye chhote din chahiye; aur day-neutral plants, jo photoperiod (din ki lambai) se mutasir hue baghair phool dete hain. Baad ki tehqeeq se pata chala ke asal faisla-kun (critical) cheez andhere (raat) ki lambai hai. Is liye short-day plants asal mein long-night plants hain. Agar unhen chhote dinon mein ugaya jaye magar lambi raat ke beech mein thori der roshni de di jaye to phool nahin aate. Aur long-day plants chhote dinon mein bhi phool de dete hain agar lambi raat ko beech mein tor diya jaye.

Phytochrome ek photoreceptor protein (roshni ko mehsoos karne wala protein) hai jo do shaklon mein hota hai: P₆₆₀ aur P₇₃₀. P₆₆₀ soi hui (quiescent, ghair-active) shakal hai. Yeh 660 nm wavelength ki surkh (red) roshni jazb kar ke active P₇₃₀ ban jata hai. P₇₃₀ 730 nm ki far-red (gehri surkh) roshni jazb kar ke wapas P₆₆₀ ban jata hai. Qudrat mein P₆₆₀ se P₇₃₀ din ki roshni mein banta hai aur P₇₃₀ se P₆₆₀ andhere mein. P₇₃₀ jis raftar se P₆₆₀ banta hai, woh pode ko andhere ki muddat naapne ki ek “ghari” (clock) de deti hai.

Tajurbon se pata chala hai ke jin halaat mein aam taur par phool aate hain, un mein surkh roshni short-day podon mein phool rokti hai magar long-day podon mein phool laati hai. Is mushahide (observation) se yeh hypothesis bana ke P₇₃₀ aur P₆₆₀ ka ek doosre mein badalna shayad phool ke waqt ko control karta hai. Is hypothesis ke mutabiq surkh roshni se bana P₇₃₀ short-day podon mein phool rokta hai aur long-day podon mein phool laata hai. P₇₃₀ din mein jama hota hai aur raat ko ghatta hai. Is liye short-day pode sirf tab phool de sakte hain jab raat itni lambi ho ke kafi P₇₃₀ wapas P₆₆₀ ban jaye aur raat ke aakhir mein phool rokne ke liye P₇₃₀ kam reh jaye. Lekin ab aam taur par mana jata hai ke phool ka waqt sirf P₆₆₀ aur P₇₃₀ ki is tabdeeli se control nahin hota. Doosri cheezein, jaise roshni ka hona ya na hona aur andhere ya roshni ke daur ki lambai, bhi phool aane mein aham kirdar ada karti hain. Jab biological clock (pode ki andar ki ghari) ko ishara mil jata hai to patton mein florigen hormone banta hai, jo phloem ke zariye phool ki kaliyon (floral buds) tak ja kar phool shuru karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke short-day podon mein lambi raat ke baad raat ke aakhir mein phool laane ke liye kafi P₇₃₀ bacha rehta hai. Magar isi paragraph mein kitab khud kehti hai ke P₇₃₀ short-day podon mein phool rokta hai. Sahi baat: lambi raat mein kafi P₇₃₀ wapas P₆₆₀ ban jata hai, is liye phool rokne wala P₇₃₀ kam reh jata hai aur short-day poda phool deta hai. Raat ke aakhir mein P₇₃₀ ka bacha rehna long-day podon ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Upar P660 (quiescent form) aur P730 (active form); surkh teer red light, 660 nm (day light) se P660 ko P730 banata hai, aur ulta teer far-red light, 730 nm ya andhere mein aahista P730 ko P660 banata hai. Neeche 24 ghante ki chaar pattiyan (peela din, kala raat): short-day plant lambi raat mein flowers; wahi raat beech mein roshni ki chamak se toot jaye to no flowers; long-day plant chhoti raat mein flowers; aur lambi raat roshni se toot jaye to bhi flowers.
blocks.caption: Phytochrome ki do shaklein aur raat ki lambai ka asar (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yahan sirf table hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Din mein surkh (red) roshni P₆₆₀ ko P₇₃₀ bana deti hai aur raat mein P₇₃₀ aahista aahista wapas P₆₆₀ banta hai; yahi pode ki ghari (clock) hai. Asal faisla raat ki lambai karti hai: lambi raat ko roshni ki ek chamak se tor diya jaye to short-day poda phool nahin deta, magar long-day poda phool de deta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is table ko “Table 7.2” kehti hai aur yeh topic “7.11” chhapa hai; yeh numbering ki ghalti hai, yeh Chapter 8 ka hissa hai. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: short-day = long-night; raat ki lambai hi asal faisla karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek kashtkar chrysanthemum ke podon ko lambi raatein deta hai, magar aadhi raat ko chand minute ke liye greenhouse ki battiyan jala deta hai. Kya phool aayenge? Phytochrome ki madad se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahin. Chrysanthemum short-day (long-night) poda hai jo sirf tab phool deta hai jab raat ek critical lambai se lambi ho. Aadhi raat ki surkh roshni P₆₆₀ ko phir P₇₃₀ bana deti hai aur lambi raat do chhoti raaton mein toot jati hai. Is liye raat ke aakhir tak phool rokne wala P₇₃₀ kafi had tak bacha rehta hai aur phool nahin aate.

items: Photoperiodism din aur raat ki lambai par phool ka jawab hai (Garner aur Allard, 1920, tambaku). Short-day plants (cocklebur, chrysanthemum, soyabean, tambaku, strawberry) ko lambi raat chahiye; long-day plants (henbane, snapdragon, cabbage, spring wheat, spring barley) ko chhoti raat; day-neutral (kheera, tamatar, matar, makai, kapas) par asar nahin. Asal cheez andhere ki lambai hai.

Phytochrome: surkh roshni (660 nm) P₆₆₀ ko active P₇₃₀ banati hai; far-red (730 nm) ya andhera use wapas P₆₆₀ banata hai; yahi raat naapne ki ghari hai. P₇₃₀ short-day podon mein phool rokta aur long-day podon mein laata hai. Ghari ishara de to patton mein florigen banta hai jo phloem se kaliyon tak jata hai.
